lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance that align with the centroid positions of the circular blobs, creating visible anchor nodes in a rectangular arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately twelve elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) positioned ventrally beneath the primary body mass and posterior to the pectoral fin.
